summary: Postinstall dropper fetches and executes remote binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Worker hosts
details: The package declares a UI drawer component but ships a postinstall script (setup.js) that assembles remote hostnames from split string arrays joined at runtime (e.g. `["oob-wor","ker.cf","99-9b3.wor","kers",".dev"].join("")`), fetches a platform-specific binary over HTTPS from `*.workers.dev` and `*.dl.well1.site` endpoints, with a DNS TXT record fallback for resolver evasion, and writes it to `/var/tmp/.cache_<tag>` on Unix or `%TEMP%/dotnet_diag_<tag>.exe` on Windows under cover-story names. setup.js then chmods the dropped file to 0755 and `execFile`s it detached. No hash or signature verification is performed and the destination hosts are anonymous, mutable CDN endpoints unrelated to the package's stated purpose. On Windows the script additionally invokes `execSync('powershell...')`. A TTL-based stamp file (analytics_state) throttles reinfection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
